families.provenance: Mindustry by Anuken (Java game on the Arc engine, Anuken's libGDX fork). Payload is the release asset 'assets.jar' downloaded unmodified from the official GitHub Releases of Anuken/Mindustry (https://github.com/Anuken/Mindustry/releases/download/<tag>/assets.jar). Six consecutive public releases 'v8 Build 160' to '160.5' (tags v160, v160.1, v160.2, v160.3, v160.4, v160.5; none marked pre-release). The jar is the game's standalone asset pack: a ZIP with about 5.7k entries, every entry individually DEFLATE-compressed (no stored entries), entry order identical across the six versions, all entry timestamps fixed at 1980-02-01. Content by compressed bytes: PNG sprites and packed texture atlases (already compressed, then deflated again), .msav maps, .woff fonts, .properties locale bundles. No upstream checksum is published; bytes are the TLS download from GitHub. Game/PAK-like because it is a real per-asset-compressed game asset container.
families.license: GPL-3.0 (Mindustry repository LICENSE; the bundled assets ship under the repository licence)

families.provenance: OpenRCT2 (open-source C++ re-implementation of RollerCoaster Tycoon 2, OpenRCT2 team; engine and producer independent of Mindustry). Source asset is the official GitHub Releases file OpenRCT2-<tag>-Linux-noble-x86_64.tar.gz for six consecutive public releases v0.5.0 to v0.5.5; each download matched the SHA-256 in the release's own OpenRCT2-<tag>-sha256sums.txt. Payload is that tarball with only the outer gzip layer removed (gzip -dc; the tar bytes are otherwise exactly as produced upstream). The tar is an uncompressed container of the full game build: engine binaries (openrct2, libopenrct2.so) plus the data/ tree with g2.dat sprites, tracks.dat, .parkobj objects and .parkap asset packs (ZIP-based, internally compressed), .parkseq title sequences, languages and docs. Producer layout: tar member order is NOT stable between releases (only ~6% of common members keep their relative order in adjacent versions), member set changes by 0 to 17 entries per release. Game/PAK-like because it is a real shipped game-data container with mixed compressed and uncompressed members.
families.license: GPL-3.0 (OpenRCT2 doc/licence.txt); bundled third-party components under their own licences as listed in doc/readme.txt

families.provenance: PowerShell by Microsoft (PowerShell/PowerShell). Source asset is the official GitHub Releases file powershell-<version>-linux-x64.tar.gz for six consecutive servicing releases of the 7.4 LTS line, v7.4.15 to v7.4.20 (all stable, none pre-release); each download matched the SHA-256 printed in its release notes. Payload is that tarball with only the outer gzip layer removed (gzip -dc). Content: a self-contained .NET 8 application build (about 670 members, ~185 MB): managed IL assemblies (System.Management.Automation.dll, Roslyn, framework assemblies), native runtime libraries (libcoreclr.so and others), XML docs and modules; members stored uncompressed in the tar. Producer layout: tar member order partly changes between releases (~54% of common members keep their relative order in adjacent versions). Application-build family because consecutive servicing builds of one shipped .NET application are compared.
families.license: MIT (PowerShell LICENSE.txt); bundled .NET runtime under MIT

families.provenance: Notepad++ by Don Ho (notepad-plus-plus/notepad-plus-plus). Payload is the release asset npp.<version>.Installer.x64.exe downloaded unmodified from the official GitHub Releases, for seven consecutive public releases v8.9.6, v8.9.6.1, v8.9.6.2, v8.9.6.4, v8.9.7, v8.9.8, v8.9.8.1 (no 8.9.6.3 release exists); each download matched the SHA-256 in the release's npp.<version>.checksums.sha256. Producer format: Authenticode-signed NSIS installer whose payload is a solid LZMA stream, so almost all bytes are compressed. Packaging pipeline change inside the history: installers up to 8.9.6.4 are built with NSIS 3.11, from 8.9.7 on with NSIS 3.12. Installer/archive family because it is a real shipped installer history.

ICU4C common data package (Unicode ICU project) as published on npmjs.org in package 'icu4c-data' (author Unicode's ICU-TC; the package used by Node.js full-icu). Source asset is the registry tarball icu4c-data-0.<major>.2.tgz for seven consecutive ICU major releases 61 to 67 (npm versions 0.61.2 ... 0.67.2; the .2 builds carry the little-endian file); each tarball matched the npm registry sha512 integrity. Payload is the single file package/icudt<major>l.dat extracted from that tarball, byte-for-byte. Format: ICU common-data archive, an uncompressed structured binary with a table of contents over many data items (CLDR locale resource bundles, collation, break-iteration, converter tables). Every major release regenerates the data from a new CLDR/Unicode version, so adjacent versions are real but broad structured changes. Structured-binary data family; it is not a database or VM image.
families.license: Unicode/ICU licence (COPYRIGHT AND PERMISSION NOTICE, ICU 58 and later; permissive, MIT-style)

families.provenance: Microsoft .NET runtime Linux package dotnet-runtime-10.0 (Microsoft.NETCore.App 10.0.x, maintainer .NET Team) from the official Microsoft package repository https://packages.microsoft.com/debian/12/prod/ (pool/main/d/dotnet-runtime-10.0/). Payload is the .deb downloaded unmodified for six consecutive servicing releases 10.0.7, 10.0.8, 10.0.9, 10.0.10-1, 10.0.11-1, 10.0.12-1; each matched the SHA-256 in the repository Packages index. Format: ar archive (debian-binary, control.tar.gz, data.tar.gz, _gpgorigin signature) whose ~82 MB of runtime files are in one whole-archive gzip stream, so the payload is almost entirely compressed. Package revision naming gains a '-1' suffix from 10.0.10; the member layout (4 ar members, 200 files) is unchanged. Negative control: whole-archive compression is expected to destroy cross-version similarity. Independent of the PowerShell family (.NET 8 there, .NET 10 here, and this payload is compressed).
families.license: MIT (.NET runtime LICENSE.txt, .NET Foundation and Contributors)
